faqs.q: How do I change my address or contact details?
faqs.a: You can change your address with the NSW Government, or update your email address or mobile number specifically with Transport for NSW.

faqs.q: What if I need to change my name or personal details?
faqs.a: You can change or correct personal details, change your name, or update your pensioner/concession details related to maritime products.

faqs.q: How can I manage my online accounts and customer numbers?
faqs.a: You can learn how to add services to your MyServiceNSW Account, apply for a customer number (for individuals or organisations), or sign up for an Online Services (myRTA.com) account.
